evidenceBasis.sourceBinaries: All three source-pack zips were downloaded from the release and their sha256 digests matched the release metadata exactly (D1 01ab34d2…, D2 8f7ef41b…, D3 70c9a6f7…). Every finding about source identity is measured against those bytes, not against the lanes' JSON.
evidenceBasis.artifacts: Artifacts were read from the lane branches with git cat-file at each family's recorded commit. Nothing was rebuilt, re-rendered or modified.
evidenceBasis.tooling: D0 modules used read-only: rcap-pdf-anchor-capture.mjs (extractTextItems/groupIntoLines, which recurses into flattened appearance XObjects), rcap-active-content.mjs (scanBytesForActiveContent), rcap-contact-sheet.mjs (missingExpectedValues), rcap-field-semantics.mjs (protectCategoryOf). Text widths were recomputed with the real metrics of the font the factory embeds (Helvetica), because the anchor extractor reports metricsExact:false for these runs and its own x2 is only an estimate.

checksThatPassedAcrossTheWholeShard: Source identity: all 84 sources resolved in the source pack; every sha256 recorded in the manifest, source-record, field-census and field map matched the actual source bytes, and every recorded byteLength matched. 0 mismatches.
documentId, revision and canonical path agree between manifest and source-record for all 84.

Output determinism: every recorded output sha256 in reports/rendered-artifacts.json reproduced the extracted artifact byte for byte across all 147 artifacts. 0 mismatches. Contact-sheet proof finalizedSha256/sheetSha256 and the manifest's contactSheetProof also matched. 0 mismatches.

Protected and outside-party fields: 194 written fields across 73 families were re-judged with the factory's own protectCategoryOf; 0 fall in a protected category. No court, clerk, prosecutor, attorney, agency, service-recipient, signature, notary, money, race or responsible-official field was written anywhere in the shard.
Placeholders: 0 occurrences of TBD, TODO, lorem ipsum, xxx, FIXME, {{…}} or <<…>> in any of the 147 artifacts.

Font floor: 0 renderer-written runs below 6pt across all 103 finalized fixtures. (Sub-6pt text does occur in KY, NM and TX artifacts, but it is the official form's own preprinted content — it is byte-identical in the untouched source and appears in the unwritten negative fixture too.)

Clipping of written values: 174 value-runs were matched to their widget geometrically and re-measured with true Helvetica metrics. 0 overflow the widget. The 24 widget slots left empty are all boundary-fixture refusals, i.e. correct fail-closed behaviour; 21 of 24 are recorded in the lane's refusal ledger (the 3 that are not are reported below).

Page count and page order: all 44 filled families have artifact page count equal to source page count, and 144 of 150 pages were confirmed in position using a probe line unique to that source page (the other 6 pages carry no line unique enough to probe). 0 reordering.

Active content in filing artifacts: all 103 finalized fixtures were written without object streams, were genuinely inspectable, and scanned clean — no XFA, no JavaScript, no /AA, no Launch/OpenAction/SubmitForm/ImportData/URI. 0 residual AcroForm fields and 0 /XFA keys in any finalized artifact.
Hold preservation: 0 production holds present in a source-record were dropped from the manifest row; currentness and legalDesign are non-empty for all 84. Nothing was silently cleared.
Non-filing holds: all 4 held families produced no PDF at all. The DO NOT COMPLETE THIS FORM FOR FILING notice was confirmed first-hand in each source binary.

Field census: census fieldCount equals the observed AcroForm field count for every acroform family, and equals fields[].length for all 84. Flat families using rcap-flat-slot-census/v1 declare slot semantics explicitly.
reviewerDetectorCorrections: An initial clipping signal on KY aoc-334/aoc-497 and MO cr360 was a false positive: the anchor extractor reports metricsExact:false for these runs, so its x2 is a fallback estimate. Re-measured with real Helvetica metrics, all three fit inside their widgets. Not reported as findings.

An initial protected-field signal on AZ CourtCaseNum and VA User.CourtName was a false positive: matter.case_number and matter.court are allowlisted CAPTION_FACTS in the factory's own semantics, and the 'court' protect rule targets judge/clerk/for-court-use fields, not the caption court name. Not reported as findings.

An initial page-order signal on 31 families was a false positive of a contiguous-substring probe that breaks when a value is inserted mid-line, and 10 further hits came from probe lines that repeat across pages. With unique probes, only 1 page failed to locate, and that probe was a row of dots. Not reported as findings.

NC:aoc-cr-287-instructions-vi initially appeared to be held on a notice absent from its own text. The notice is in fact drawn in an offset subset font; decoding it confirms the lane's recorded notice verbatim. Not reported as a finding — the lane did the harder, correct thing.

confirmed.verdict: CONFIRMED as a D0 factory defect
confirmed.detail: rcap-pdf-anchor-capture.mjs loadFonts() reads only Subtype/FirstChar/Widths/MissingWidth and never consults /ToUnicode or /Encoding /Differences, so subset-encoded documents decode to garbage and read as unreadable. confirmed.verdict: CONFIRMED, though not as a UTF-8 problem

confirmed.verdict: CONFIRMED as a source property, not a factory bug

systemicFindings.scope: all 44 of 44 contact sheets in shard 0
systemicFindings.implementationBranch: all seven lane branches (inherited from D0)
systemicFindings.family: cross-cutting — every family that has a contact sheet
systemicFindings.visibleDefect: buildContactSheet saves with pdf-lib defaults, so every contact sheet uses object streams. scanBytesForActiveContent then returns { hits: [], inspectable: false, compressed: true } — its own documented refusal to give a verdict — and callers record the empty hits array as a clean result. Every one of the 44 contact sheets in shard 0 is therefore unverified for active content, and in 20 of them that unverified pass is masking real residue (confirmed by re-serializing without object streams). The finalized filing artifacts are unaffected: all 103 were written without object streams, were genuinely inspectable, and scanned clean.
systemicFindings.likelyOwner: D0 shared factory — rcap-contact-sheet.mjs buildContactSheet(); and every caller of scanBytesForActiveContent that tests hits.length without testing inspectable.
systemicFindings.acceptanceCondition: scanBytesForActiveContent's inspectable:false must be treated as a failure by every caller, never as a pass; buildContactSheet must save with { useObjectStreams: false } and assert a clean, inspectable verdict before writing. Re-running the scan on every contact sheet must then report inspectable:true, and any family whose sheet reports hits must be corrected before approval.

findings.visibleDefect: Lane D1C records the source pointer as `canonicalRelativePath` (pack-relative, e.g. "STATES/VT/02_PACKET_FORMS/VT__FORM__200-00132__stipulation-to-seal-cri...") while all six other lanes use `canonicalBundlePath` (Edition-1-prefixed). The manifest builder reads only canonicalBundlePath, so every D1C family — all 11 in shard 0, 47 lane-wide — carries sourceCanonicalPath: null in the review manifest. An importer keyed on that field silently loses the source pointer for the entire D1C lane. The underlying evidence is sound: I resolved each D1C source by its own key and every recorded sha256 matched the source bytes exactly.
findings.likelyOwner: scripts/rcap-official-forms/build-d-review-manifest.mjs (reads one key only), with lane D1C's divergent source-record schema as the contributing cause.
findings.acceptanceCondition: Either normalize D1C source-records to `canonicalBundlePath` with the Edition-1 prefix, or make the manifest builder accept both keys and normalize to one form. Afterwards no family in corrected-review-manifest.json may have a null sourceCanonicalPath, and each value must resolve to a file in the source pack whose sha256 equals the family's sourceSha256.

findings.fieldOrRegion: anchorCapture: 199 lines across 6 pages, readableLines 0 on every page
findings.visibleDefect: The family is dispositioned "overlay_no_extractable_text_layer" and produced no fill, but the source does have a text layer: it draws 199 lines. The text is a subset font whose codes are offset (a +29 shift), and decoding it yields plain, usable content — e.g. page 1 of blake-006 reads "District/Municipal Court of Washington, County/City of ... No. ... Plaintiff ... Defendant ... DOB". So the stated premise ('no extractable text layer') is false, and a form that could have been anchored and overlaid was dropped.
findings.likelyOwner: D0 shared factory — scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-pdf-anchor-capture.mjs, loadFonts(): it reads only Subtype/FirstChar/Widths/MissingWidth and never consults /ToUnicode or /Encoding /Differences, so content-stream byte codes are used verbatim as characters. Lane D1B's NC decoder shows the correct approach is available (source-record decodeBasis 'page_content_stream_tounicode_decoded_per_run', cmapsConsulted 9).
findings.acceptanceCondition: loadFonts must build a code->unicode map from each font's /ToUnicode CMap (falling back to /Encoding /Differences and the standard encodings) and extractTextItems must emit decoded characters. After the fix, anchorCapture for blake-006 and blake-008 must report readableLines > 0 on every page, and each family must be re-dispositioned on the real anchor set rather than on 'no extractable text layer'.
